title: ZX Spectrum System Tour: Text Mode
summary: A technical deep-dive into the ZX Spectrum's text mode system, exploring how this classic 1980s 8-bit home computer handled character display through its ULA graphics chip and memory layout. The article covers the underlying hardware architecture and software techniques used to render text on screen.
problem_solved: Explains the technical implementation of text rendering on the ZX Spectrum's limited hardware resources.
why_valuable: Provides valuable historical documentation of early 8-bit computing techniques for retro computing enthusiasts and those studying computer graphics evolution.
